model.title: Geographical indications: aligning EU rules with changes to the provisions under the Lisbon Agreement

summary.text: This proposal aims to update European rules about geographical indications—special labels that protect products named after their region of origin—to match changes made to an international agreement on the same subject. The changes would ensure that European protections for regional products like Champagne or Parmigiano-Reggiano stay aligned with evolving international standards.
